verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent capabilities. Deep Research does in-depth, real-time research using Google Search as a source, and Connected Apps let Gemini take actions in other apps with permission. Nothing documents Gemini driving a web browser to navigate sites or complete tasks on them. missing for 10: documented browser-control/computer-use agent, ability to click, fill forms or complete transactions on arbitrary websites, user oversight/confirmation controls for web actions, hands-on or independent corroboration.
